info.title: Hudson local agent API
info.description: Preview API for a loopback-only, single-identity host. Unversioned paths follow the reviewed preview contract in docs/api-compatibility.json. Configured mode loads agents at startup; authenticated catalog mode publishes immutable tools and agents through approved operator connections. Credential issuance remains an offline operator action. All timestamps are Unix milliseconds. Model and tool execution is asynchronous relative to submissions. When started with --require-api-token, every route requires a persisted scoped bearer credential. Without that option this is an unprotected loopback development API. Authentication mode is a host setting, not a per-request choice. Hosted multi-tenant serving and event streaming are not implemented.

post.description: Messages and keys are scoped to the actor-owned run. Steering takes priority and one message is consumed per complete boundary. Follow-ups wait for a verified answer. Limits: 16 pending messages, 64 KiB including queue metadata, and 128 lifetime keys per run. Queue controls do not approve tools, answer saved questions, reconcile uncertainty, or resume execution. Exact replay remains valid after consumption or withdrawal.

post.summary: Admit a new independent task from explicitly transferred context
post.description: Start a fresh task with transferred context and optional inline images for the new turn. Published mode requires agent_ref; configured mode rejects it. Target goals, policies and budgets apply afresh. Image bytes bind the retry key. These endpoints share a 5 MiB body ceiling, four large-request slots and a 30-second HTTP deadline. Native credentials, approvals and operation evidence are never inherited.

post.summary: Submit JSON task input with explicit inline user images
post.description: At most four images per new turn, 2 MiB decoded per image and 4 MiB combined encoded data per model request. Agent payload/context limits also apply. This 5 MiB endpoint shares four large-request slots and a 30-second request deadline with import/fork. Input schema validates the original JSON task. Image bytes participate in idempotency. No paths or URLs are resolved. Published mode requires agent_ref; configured mode rejects it.

evidence.description: Successful recorded tool executions; provenance alone does not establish factual correctness.

status.description: Publication evidence only; published means scheduler acceptance, not task start or completion.

published_at.description: Original acknowledgment timestamp; absent in legacy snapshots.

Transcript.description: At most 4 MiB and 4096 combined messages. Format 1 accepts text/JSON/tools; format 2 adds inline images in live user messages. Image-bearing exports use format 2. Complete tool exchanges only; provider state and unresolved artifact IDs are rejected. Archives retain quoted evidence, with images kept live.

Image.description: Inline standard base64 only, at most 2 MiB decoded. No paths, URLs or provider file IDs. Hudson validates encoding and size; providers validate image format.

quoted_at.description: UTC allocation-admission time in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

allocation_nano_usd.description: Exact unsigned nano USD decimal string. 1000000000 units equal one USD.

anyOf.description: Exact unsigned nano USD decimal string. 1000000000 units equal one USD.

RunSpend.description: Actor-owned model allocation records. Priced usage uses reported tokens and pinned operator rates. Missing reports retain allocations. Empty entries with enabled=false indicate unavailable pricing, not zero provider consumption.
